title: Film playback
text: Playback singing for film composers and producers in Telugu, Tamil and Kannada.

title: Concerts & SPB evenings
text: Film-music and light-music concerts, including evenings celebrating the songs of S. P. Balasubrahmanyam.

title: International concerts
text: Performances for cultural associations, festivals and charities outside India.

title: Temple festivals & bhakti
text: Devotional concerts with bhajans, keerthanas and songs suited to the deity and occasion.

title: Celebrations
text: Weddings, receptions and milestone events, with a programme shaped around the occasion.

title: Albums & recordings
text: Studio work for producers and labels in any of his four languages.

title: Voice & dubbing
text: Character voices for films and television, as for Basava in Sing Geetham, plus voice-overs and narration.

title: Television
text: Music shows and tributes, as on ETV’s Swarabhishekam and Paadutha Theeyaga.
